name: shared_list
description: What others shared with you: open a folder (shows the shared browser), an album or a photo; leave a share. Reached by: app go_to shared.

actions.name: ask_leave
actions.description: Leave a share by its id in items: asks first, as the Leave action does

actions.name: cancel_leave
actions.description: Answer no to "Leave …?". Only while it is asked (leaving set)

actions.name: confirm_leave
actions.description: Answer yes to "Leave …?": the share goes from the list. Only while it is asked (leaving set)

actions.name: open
actions.description: Open a row by its id in items: a folder opens in the shared browser (screen shared), an album in its page, a photo in the viewer. Not a file: it opens in another app

actions.name: refresh
actions.description: Reload the list, as pulling down does; also tries again after an error

id.description: The share's id: what open and ask_leave take

subjectId.description: The folder, file or album's own id (an open folder is the shared screen's folderId)

canEdit.description: You may edit it ("Can edit"); else view only

photoCount.description: Photos in an album; null for folders and files

items.description: What other people shared with you, newest first; null until the first load

leaving.description: The share id waiting for "Leave …?": confirm_leave or cancel_leave

message.description: What became of a file a person opened with another app
